context: A barista shows her friend how to handle restaurant orders and tipping abroad
purpose: Teach: オーダー/チップ/シティ/昼食/西洋/ならでは/異なっ/なんとも

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 海外旅行、いよいよ来週だね。レストランでの作法、ちゃんと予習した?
lines.en: Your trip abroad is finally next week. Did you study restaurant etiquette properly?
lines.style: Casual friendly tone, slightly teasing older-sister energy

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それがね、西洋のレストランって日本と全然違うって聞いて、ちょっと不安なの。
lines.en: Well, I heard Western restaurants are totally different from Japanese ones, so I'm a bit nervous.
lines.style: Soft worried voice, seeking reassurance from a close friend

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、まず店員さんがテーブルに来てオーダーを取るのを待つの。勝手に呼んじゃダメだよ。
lines.en: Right, first you wait for the server to come take your order. Don't just call them over.
lines.style: Instructive but warm, like a patient barista coaching a friend

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、日本の感覚とはずいぶん異なってるんだね。手を挙げて呼ぶのが普通だと思ってた。
lines.en: Wow, that's quite different from the Japanese way. I thought raising your hand was normal.
lines.style: Genuine surprise, soft melodic delivery with rising intonation

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そう、それと一番大事なのがチップ。アメリカだと食事代の十八パーセントくらいが目安かな。
lines.en: Yeah, and the most important thing is the tip. In America, about eighteen percent of the meal is standard.
lines.style: Knowledgeable tone, sharing insider barista wisdom warmly

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そんなに!?ニューヨーク・シティのカフェで昼食食べるだけで、なんとも高くつきそう…。
lines.en: That much?! Even just having lunch at a New York City cafe sounds incredibly expensive...
lines.style: Mildly shocked, voice rising in genuine disbelief and worry

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でしょ?日本ならではの『お会計ぴったり』文化が恋しくなるかもね。
lines.en: Right? You might start missing Japan's unique culture of paying exactly the bill.
lines.style: Knowing chuckle, nostalgic and warm with gentle teasing

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に。チップ制度って、慣れるまでなんとも落ち着かない気がする。
lines.en: Truly. The tipping system feels somehow unsettling until you get used to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful reflection, slightly anxious undertone in voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 大丈夫、現地でも昼食のときに練習すればすぐ慣れるよ。楽しんできてね!
lines.en: Don't worry, if you practice at lunch over there, you'll get used to it quickly. Have fun!
lines.style: Encouraging upbeat closing, warm send-off energy
